questions.q: What was the name of Nutkin's brother?
choices: Twinkleberry
Old Brown
Timmy Tiptoes
Hitty Pitty
questions.evidence: He had a brother called Twinkleberry

questions.q: How did the squirrels get across the lake to Owl Island?
choices: They swam across with their sacks
They made little rafts out of twigs
They rode on the back of Old Brown
They walked over a long fallen log
questions.evidence: They made little rafts out of twigs

questions.q: What did the squirrels use as a sail on their rafts?
choices: A big green leaf
Their own tails
A dock-leaf
An old sack
questions.evidence: spread out his tail for a sail

questions.q: How did the other squirrels act when they asked Old Brown for nuts?
choices: They shouted riddles at him
They bowed and spoke politely
They tickled him with a nettle
They threw sticks at his door
questions.evidence: each made a low bow, and said politely

questions.q: How did Nutkin behave toward Old Brown?
choices: He was quiet and shy
He was rude and sang riddles at him
He brought him the biggest present
He helped him carry food inside
questions.evidence: Nutkin was excessively impertinent in his manners

questions.q: The story says Nutkin was "impertinent." What does that mean?
choices: Very sleepy and slow
Rude and cheeky
Kind and helpful
Quiet and afraid
questions.evidence: Nutkin became more and more impertinent

questions.q: What present did the squirrels bring on the fifth day?
choices: A fat mole
Wild honey
Six beetles
A new-laid egg
questions.evidence: On the fifth day the squirrels brought a present of wild honey

questions.q: What did Nutkin do just before Old Brown caught him?
choices: He played ninepins on a flat rock
He jumped right onto Old Brown's head
He peeped in through the key-hole
He ran home across the lake on a raft
questions.evidence: he took a running jump right onto the head of Old Brown

questions.q: How did Nutkin escape from Old Brown?
choices: His tail broke and he ran out the attic window
Twinkleberry came in and pulled him out the door
He bit Old Brown and ran out the front door
He hid in a sack of nuts until Old Brown slept
questions.evidence: his tail broke in two, and he dashed up the staircase and escaped out of the attic window

questions.q: What lesson does this story teach?
choices: Always gather nuts before the winter comes
Owls are kind to everyone who visits them
Being rude and showing off can get you in trouble
Squirrels are better at riddles than owls are
questions.evidence: Old Mr. Brown turned up his eyes in disgust at the impertinence of Nutkin.
